boundary.description: From the River Mersey, along Palatine Road, Barlow Moor Road, Elm Road, Lapwing Lane, Fog Lane, Prince’s Avenue, then by a diagonal beeline through Fog Lane Park to Parrs Wood Road and West Croft Road, and along Westcroft Road and Barcicroft Road to the Manchester – Stockport MBC boundary and along this boundary to the River Mersey and by the River Mersey to Palatine Road.
